description: The Klio operator manages the lifecycle of Klio components in a Kubernetes cluster. Klio is a cloud-native backup solution for PostgreSQL databases, designed to work seamlessly with CloudNativePG.

linkding: a self-hosted bookmark manager with tags, full-text search, archived snapshots and a REST API, on SQLite or PostgreSQL. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
